text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tourism sector needs long-term stategy to overcome crisis.
- Michael Jackson fans disappointed after news that his show has not been given the green light.
- Morocco issues draft constitution to be approved by referendum on September 13.
- Trade ministry to create fund to finance small businesses investment projects.
- Burkina Faso President Blaise Compaore says in interview to Moroccan daily Quotidien du Maroc "Africa must prepare integration in world market".
- Thousands made homeless after fire destroyed shantytown in Casablanca.
